# Sensorika (סנסוריקה / Сенсорика)

> Sensorika is a clinic in Karmiel, Israel, offering diagnosis and treatment in sensory regulation (ויסות חושי; Russian: сенсорная интеграция) for children with special needs. It is run by Anna Milman (אנה מילמן), a sensory regulation diagnostician and therapist who works with the NDFA neuro-developmental functional approach of Prof. Rami Katz. The site is in Hebrew (default) and Russian.

- Location: Karmiel, Israel. Group activities take place at Studio Tabasco, 6 HaGalil St., Karmiel (רח׳ הגליל 6, כרמיאל).
- Contact: phone and WhatsApp +972 54-454-8600.
- Individual work: one-on-one sensory-functional diagnosis, then a treatment plan built around the child.
- Group work: small neuro-developmental groups by age (5–7, 8–10, 11–13) for children who find it hard to join regular after-school activities.
- Sessions, individual or group, last 45 minutes.
- No formal diagnosis is needed to get in touch; the work addresses the child's functional difficulties, including for children with autism or ADHD.
